a.text: She won the girls U8 section at the Asian Youth Chess Championship in Tehran.

b.text: She won the girls U8 section at the World Youth Chess Championships in Vũng Tàu, Vietnam.

a.text: She was voted the best girl under-20 player of 2013 at the 1st Annual Asian Chess Excellence Awards.

b.text: She won the bronze medal in the Asian Womens Blitz Championship of 2014.

a.text: She won the womens championship of Kazakhstan.
